item.text: {"critiques":[{"candidate_id":"release-policy-baseline-v1","result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality uses != instead of hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14 compares the digest strings with !=.","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths; malformed values can also raise instead of failing closed.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-18 uses roots and change[\"path\"] without validation. A missing path raises KeyError, and an empty root matches every path.","claim_ids":["x2","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Scope matching uses a raw string prefix, so a sibling path can pass.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 allows path \"release-extra/file\" under root \"release\" because startswith returns true.","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources and actions are ignored, allowing an out-of-scope source or unknown action to pass.","evidence":"release_policy.py:17-19 reads only change[\"path\"]; a record with path \"release/file\", an out-of-scope rename source, or an unknown action can return true.","claim_ids":["x4","x5"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}},{"candidate_id":"refactor-baseline-v1","result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Production dispatch functions still call legacy_route instead of route_request directly.","evidence":"routing.py:22 and routing.py:26 call legacy_route.","claim_ids":["c1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"legacy_route duplicates the routing implementation instead of directly delegating to route_request.","evidence":"routing.py:13-19 defines its own routes dictionary and lookup.","claim_ids":["x1"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}}],"schema_version":1}
